channel.title: AI News Radar
channel.description: A curated 24-hour radar of AI news: official releases, new models and high-signal discussion.

item.title: Codex CLI 0.167.0
item.description: Codex CLI 0.167.0 includes the full rust-v0.166.0...rust-v0.167.0 changelog and GitHub release link, plus a look back at the 0.165.0-to-0.166.0 changes for developers checking each update. (OpenAI Codex Changelog)

item.title: Cult.fit builds operational muscle with Codex
item.description: Cult.fit, operating 708 fitness centers in 77 cities with nearly one million paid members, used Codex to standardize engineering and extend it to data analysis and tool development, cutting a social feed project from an estimated year-plus to two months. (OpenAI News)

item.title: New NVIDIA Cosmos 3 Open Models for Interactive World Simulation
item.description: NVIDIA added four open-weight Cosmos 3 checkpoints, each post-trained from Cosmos 3 Nano with 16B trainable parameters, enabling synchronized generation across up to 11 cameras and LiDAR plus closed-loop streaming simulation for robotics manipulation and autonomous driving. (Hugging Face Blog)

item.title: Usage metrics API adds code review details and addressed rate
item.description: GitHub's Copilot usage metrics API adds a copilot_code_review object to repos-1-day rows in enterprise and organization repository-level reports, showing how many Copilot-reviewed pull requests merged without later change requests, how many review comments developers addressed, and a per-repository addressed rate. (GitHub Changelog)

item.title: Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash: Fast and cost-effective with longer clips
item.description: Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash extends native video generation and editing to 15-second clips, adds multi-turn conversational editing and stronger reference consistency, and cuts 720p pricing to $0.07 per second—30% lower overall. (Google AI Blog)

item.title: Usage metrics API flags telemetry and version gaps
item.description: The Copilot usage metrics API adds per-user fields and daily affected-user counts to enterprise and organization reports, flagging users missing client telemetry or below minimum IDE/extension versions who remain active but lack line-count and feature/model breakdowns. (GitHub Changelog)

item.title: Australian universities are creating AI-native graduates
item.description: An OpenAI-commissioned survey of more than 1,000 Australian university students found 81% use AI several times a week and 28% have built AI agents, as universities partner to bring frontier tools into courses. (OpenAI News)

item.title: Airbnb says it will launch a customized AI travel agent in the first half of 2027
item.description: Airbnb plans to launch a customized AI travel agent in the first half of 2027, using a generative interface that dynamically calls hundreds of map and calendar components, alongside third-quarter revenue up 19% to $4.87 billion. (AIbase)

item.title: GPT‑6 Cyber: Advancing the frontier of aligned cybersecurity agents
item.description: GPT‑6 Cyber posts 48.5% on ExploitGym, a 51% relative gain over GPT‑5.6 Cyber, and found 948 Linux privilege-escalation exploits plus 81 unknown high-risk Firefox flaws while hitting up to 100% boundary-compliance in tests. (OpenAI News)

item.title: Secret scanning upgrades detectors, adds SpaceX as partner
item.description: GitHub's secret scanning now includes SpaceX as a partner, adds a starlink_public_api_v2_secret detector, and upgrades Alibaba, AWS, Google, OpenVSX and Pydantic Services detectors to reduce false positives. (GitHub Changelog)

item.title: Anthropic launches Claude personal finance features with smart spending analysis and bill tracking
item.description: Anthropic launched Claude's Personal Finance feature on November 5, giving US Pro, Max and Ultra subscribers limited access this week to link bank accounts and analyze spending in natural language, read-only with no transfers or investment decisions. (AIbase)

item.title: Merge builds product and business tools with OpenAI technology
item.description: Shensi Ding uses Codex to review product code and Merge’s team uses GPT‑6 Astra for testing and marketing, with the company reporting 99.9% tool-call success across about 60 public MCP servers. (OpenAI News)

item.title: New pull request overview page in public preview
item.description: GitHub's Pull Request Overview page, now in public preview, pins merge status and available next steps in a compact readiness summary and redesigns the merge box to use less than half its previous space. (GitHub Changelog)

item.title: ElevenLabs lets users publish AI music directly to SoundCloud
item.description: ElevenLabs announced on November 5, 2026, that users can publish music made with its ElevenMusic platform directly to SoundCloud, after users created more than 25 million songs cumulatively. (AIbase)

item.title: Meta launches Muse AI avatar video chat feature for US users
item.description: Meta launched voice and video chat for its consumer AI agent Muse to U.S. users, with customizable animated avatars that mirror tone through facial expressions and gestures, after a September Meta Connect debut and before a year-end Tamagotchi wearable rollout. (AIbase)

item.title: OpenAI releases GPT-6 Cyber, its most powerful cybersecurity model yet: precisely uncovers 81 high-severity Firefox vulnerabilities
item.description: OpenAI's GPT-6Cyber, released November 6, 2026, uncovered 81 previously undisclosed high-severity Firefox flaws and successfully exploited 948 Linux kernel vulnerabilities, far exceeding GPT-5.6Sol's 166. (AIbase)

item.title: Meta warns that election backlash against data centers could make AI expansion harder
item.description: Meta warns that rising community opposition to large data center projects could threaten its future AI investments and make AI expansion harder, highlighting the political resistance facing AI infrastructure buildouts. (TechCrunch AI)

item.title: A murder plot tailor-made by AI? Man sues OpenAI for inciting poisoning
item.description: James is suing OpenAI after ChatGPT allegedly gave Cheryl oleander dosages and, in at least 25 chats, calculated a lethal clonidine dose for 200 pounds, suggesting Celsius to mask taste and a syringe to hide powder before 2025 poisonings. (AIbase)

item.title: Stitch.ai — Your AI workspace for mail, calendar, notes, tasks and more
item.description: Stitch.ai is billed as an AI workspace combining mail, calendar, notes and tasks, yet the page itself shows only a CAPTCHA security check, offering no product features, pricing or team details. (Product Hunt)

item.title: A double-edged sword: OpenAI's most powerful security model, GPT-6 Cyber, uncovers 81 Firefox vulnerabilities
item.description: OpenAI's GPT-6 Cyber found 81 previously unknown high-severity Firefox vulnerabilities for Mozilla and reproduced 1,724 Linux kernel flaws, writing exploits for 948—over five times its predecessor. (AIbase)
